• Product description: 

Introducing Carpe Diem's Seize the Summer Combo: the ultimate package for men who want to make a splash in style. This exclusive combo includes two premium men's swim shorts, each meticulously designed with a super comfortable liner and captivating details, along with a complimentary premium heavy oversized tee.

Crafted with the utmost attention to detail, our swim shorts feature a super comfortable liner that ensures a luxurious and comfortable fit. Say goodbye to discomfort and hello to all-day relaxation, whether you're lounging by the pool or taking a dip in the ocean. The liner is designed to provide maximum comfort and support, allowing you to seize every moment of summer without any distractions.

But it's the amazing little details that truly make our swim shorts stand out. From the intricate stitching to the carefully selected & Carpe Diem branded hardware, every element has been thoughtfully crafted to exude elegance and sophistication. These swim shorts are a testament to our commitment to quality and style.

And as a special bonus for supporting the boys, we're including a premium heavy oversized tee with your purchase. Made from the finest cotton materials, this tee is designed to offer a comfortable and relaxed fit. Whether you wear it as a cover-up at the beach or pair it with your fit for a casual night outing, this tee adds an extra layer of style to your summer wardrobe.

Carpe Diem's Seize the Summer Combo is the ultimate expression of luxury and fashion-forwardness. Embrace the spirit of adventure and make a statement with our premium men's swim shorts and complimentary oversized tee. Get ready to seize the summer in style and create memories that will last a lifetime. Let’s ride boys. 

We will reach out to make sure shirt size is same as shorts as well as color of shirt as we will honor any color as long as it is in stock.
